title: duggena rugosa
intro: Duggena rugosa, commonly known as Japanese angelica tree, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to East Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving circulation, and relieving symptoms of menopause and menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of Duggena rugosa include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, making it a potential treatment for various conditions, including arthritis and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Duggena rugosa include lignans, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
